name: list_knowledge_topics
title: List FIRMS documentation topics
description:
Table of contents of the FIRMS knowledge base: the FIRMS FAQ (in the FAQ's own sections and order) and supplements (Fire Map disclaimer, LANCE disclaimer and acknowledgments, attribute definitions, FIRMS API pages), with the sources they were taken from.

Without arguments it returns each section's ID, title, and entry count. Pass `section` to list that section's entry IDs and titles, or `include_entries: true` to list every entry. Then read entries with get_knowledge_entry or search them with search_knowledge.

This tool does not need a FIRMS MAP_KEY.
